summary:
Found one issue:

- **P2 runtime cost:** GC helpers clear all cache addresses twice. [gc_struct.go](/tmp/wago-gc-loop-keyed-value-homes/src/core/compiler/backend/railshot/amd64/gc_struct.go:1134) clears them, then always calls [callHostSync](/tmp/wago-gc-loop-keyed-value-homes/src/core/compiler/backend/railshot/amd64/call.go:1291), which clears them again. With eight entries, each helper emits 16 stores instead of eight. Remove the first clear.

No safety fault found in the key/address protocol, roots, frame packing, traps, null/i31/foreign handling, or register use.

Test gaps: no direct cross-instance test and no test that a proven read-only callee keeps the cache.

I did not build or run tests, as requested.
